name: aeg-d-dwarfs
title: Local Group dwarf galaxies: published line-of-sight dispersions with population mass-to-light ratios and atomic gas
description: Atlas conversion of the published velocity dispersions of Milky Way, M31 and Local Group field dwarf galaxies (A5) and ambiguous systems (A7) into one g_obs and g_bar per system at the 3D half-light radius (D-025). The Local Volume Database (Pace 2025, CC0) is the index; every value is read twice from the original papers (D-048). Structure, distance and magnitude by D-052 to D-055 and D-061; stellar M/L_V by D-039, D-057, D-059 and D-060; atomic gas from Putman et al. 2021 (D-058). See REPRODUCTION.md, reading/ and docs/decisions.md.
x_licence_status: LVDB CC0. Original papers: values transcribed with citation, not redistributed. AAS machine-readable tables and VizieR exports linked, not redistributed. Atlas tables intended CC BY 4.0 under D-004, citing the sources.
